entries.query: What is a drawback of the FCFS disk scheduling algorithm?
entries.subject: operating systems
entries.review_notes: Explains FCFS serves disk requests strictly in arrival order regardless of track position, causing more physical head movement than necessary (illustrated with a worked track-number example).
